report_name: Broadcom Patches Critical VMware VM Escape Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-59346
vulnerabilities.description: A critical integer overflow vulnerability in the VMXNET3 virtual network adapter allows an attacker with local administrative privileges on a guest VM to execute arbitrary code on the host operating system, constituting a full VM escape.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-59347
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability allows an attacker with local administrative privileges on a guest VM to execute code within the VMX process on the host.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process of VMware VMX
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process of VMware VMX
id: 2b8f3c1a-7d4e-4b9f-8c2a-9e1f0a3d8b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes (e.g., shells) spawned by the VMware VMX process, which could indicate a VM escape as described in CVE-2026-59346 and CVE-2026-59347.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/vmware-workstation-and-fusion-updates-patch-critical-vulnerability/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-05
tags:
  - attack.t1611
  - attack.t1068
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\vmware-vmx.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects suspicious child processes (e.g., shells) spawned by the VMware VMX process. This activity is suggested as a hunting hint for potential exploitation of VM escape vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-59346.

indicators.name: VMware VMX Process Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: VMware VMX Process Execution
id: 8e4d2c1b-9f0a-4b8d-a1c3-7b6e5d4f3c2a
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of the VMware VMX process. This is generally benign but can be used for context in investigations related to virtualization.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/vmware-workstation-and-fusion-updates-patch-critical-vulnerability/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-05
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vmware-vmx.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the VMware VMX process, which is a key component in VMware virtualization products. While normally benign, monitoring this process is recommended for hunting potential VM escape exploits.
